alternative_explanations: Any gain may reflect generic shrinkage, zero-padding coordinate coincidence or finite-support regularization rather than a portable representation; a loss may reflect this fixed linear prior rather than all shared learners.
confounds: Invalidate on family labels, native types, paths, semantic channel alignment, hand-written ontology, train/test world overlap, test-output access, source or hyperparameter differences across causal roles, post-score tuning, certificate mismatch, budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any candidate receives a family label, source path, native type or semantic channel name.
Invalidate if normalization reads a holdout output or any value outside assigned slow-fit worlds.
Invalidate if a history, support or forecast window crosses a whole-world or DS08a cycle boundary.
Invalidate if shared, independent, cross-family-only or support-only changes learner source or hyperparameters.
Invalidate if masked loss is not averaged within world and equally across the three evaluator-private families.
Invalidate if acquisition, normalization, fit, adaptation, query, update, bytes, state or R1/R4/R16 cost is omitted.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, scoring-seed leakage, external model/API use or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard this exact rank-4 ridge-0.001 shrinkage-0.5 learner if either causal gain is non-positive overall or in any family, if rollout stability fails, if the source-identical semantic fixture fails, or if a simpler implementable baseline Pareto-dominates it.

outcome_policy.negative: Discard this exact masked spectral prior if either preregistered causal contrast is non-positive in any family or a simpler implementable control dominates; a crash rejects the implementation, while an integrity failure invalidates the experiment.
outcome_policy.null: Treat near-zero causal gains or mixed family signs as inconclusive-to-negative for this exact learner and do not tune rank, ridge or shrinkage against the observed seed.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only an unchanged three-runner-seed screen of the exact learner and controls; do not mark promising, promote, claim scaling, general intelligence or an LLM successor.

predicted_outcome: If cross-world transition geometry is genuinely transferable, the shared assignment will have positive shared-versus-independent gain overall and in every family, while foreign-family-only training will beat support-only adaptation in every family; all rollouts remain finite and the shared learner is not Pareto-dominated after full cost. Because the families are heterogeneous, a valid null or negative is plausible.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. A valid one-seed conjunctive positive with both causal gains positive in every family, stable rollout and implementable Pareto non-dominance may authorize only an unchanged three-seed screen.
research_question: Can one source-identical family-blind masked spectral transition prior learn transferable dynamics across three different world families with better unseen-world quality per fully charged cost than independent, foreign-family-only, support-only and simpler probabilistic controls?
title: Shared masked spectral transition prior across three unseen-world families
